subject: music
title: Pitch, Duration & Dynamics
welcome_lead: The musical alphabet — how high, how long, how loud.
meta_desc: KS3 elements of music: pitch, duration, dynamics intro.
final_note: Three of the building blocks of every song.

concepts.def: How high or low a sound is.
How loud or quiet music is.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. A piccolo sounds high; a tuba sounds low. Pitch is measured in Hertz (Hz) — vibrations per second.
Duration is how long a note lasts. Music is built from short notes, long notes, and rests in between.
Dynamics use Italian words: p (piano = quiet), mp (medium quiet), mf (medium loud), f (forte = loud), ff (very loud).
